environment.description: Same Ktor microservice on ECS Fargate in us-east-1 VPC (vpc-0d7f91ca). Service uses IAM task role 'arn:aws:iam::112233445566:role/reporting-service-role' with s3:PutObject on 'arn:aws:s3:::*'. VPC has a gateway endpoint for S3 (vpce-0ef82d19) with a custom endpoint policy. The endpoint policy document uses a StringNotEquals condition on 's3:ResourceAccount' matching the owning account '112233445566', combined with a Deny statement for any PutObject where the bucket ARN does not match 'arn:aws:s3:::internal-reports-prod/*'. Note: the endpoint policy applies at the network layer before IAM evaluation, so even if IAM allows broad s3:PutObject, the VPC endpoint will reject requests to non-matching buckets with a 403 AccessDenied before the request reaches S3.

config.route_table: all S3 traffic routes exclusively through vpce-0ef82d19
